agyos_skill.intent: Turn ideas into reality using the Time to Materialize (TTM) 3-step framework: reverse engineer the smallest proof of success, apply the 24-hour execution constraint, and compress feedback loops through single-variable iteration.
agyos_skill.instructions: This skill codifies the Time to Materialize (TTM) framework for rapidly transitioning concepts from ideation into validated real-world execution. TTM stands for **Time to Materialize**—the duration between conceiving an idea and putting a tangible version into the real world. - **Validation Over Perfection**: The initial objective of any idea is not perfection; it is empirical validation. - **Execution Generates Clarity**: Elaborate planning without market contact creates paralysis. Real-world feedback produces the data required to decide what to build next. Start with the end result, not the implementation process or toolchain. 1. **Identify the Smallest Proof of Potential**: - Ask: *What is the single smallest result that proves this idea has real potential?* - Examples: - **Software & SaaS**: Securing the first paying customer or signed letter of intent. - **Content Creation**: Publishing the first post that secures audience engagement or a brand inquiry. - **Consulting & Services**: Booking the first paid discovery session. - **Digital Products**: Processing the first live transaction. 2. **Eliminate Premature Systems**: - Do not build support infrastructure, automation pipelines, or administrative tooling until the single proof metric is demonstrated. Apply the 24-hour constraint to force radical scope reduction: 1. **The Forcing Question**: - *If this had to happen in the next 24 hours, what would I do?* 2. **Build the Smallest Possible Version**: - Instead of building a complex multi-page website -> Deploy a single landing page with a direct call to action. - Instead of building an entire multi-week curriculum -> Host and sell a single live workshop. - Instead of planning a 100-video calendar -> Record, edit, and publish video number one. - Instead of incorporating an agency -> Pitch one target client directly. 3. **Ship and Measure**: - Deploy the minimal asset into public view immediately. Growth velocity is bounded by how quickly real-world learning occurs.
